_note: Fill one entry per photo, then run: python python/import_photos.py   (needs internet). Use 'url' (direct image link) or 'local' (a file you downloaded). 'page', 'credit' and 'license' are required so every photo is traceable. Unsplash and Pexels licences allow free commercial use; still read the licence on each photo page, avoid photos with visible brands or text, and never describe stock people as NexaCare staff or patients.
